purpose: Close the c=N decode gaps so no Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_S gfx1151 decode concurrency below 512 falls to WMMA prefill: (1) general native rowtile8 chunking for single Q4/Q5 projections at rows 9..511, (2) gate/up dual rowtile8 policy extended to rows 2..511, (3) Q6 lm_head rowtile (standard + qmicro planar) extended to rows 8 so c8 lm_head is one launch instead of 4+4.

software.env: none needed for lm_head (GGUF_Q6_LM_HEAD_MAX_CHUNK default now 8; the prior HIPENGINE_GGUF_Q6_LM_HEAD_MAX_CHUNK=4 workaround is obsolete)

combination_map.note: gfx1151 Qwen3.8 Q4_K_S native decode session; rows >= 512 stays WMMA prefill (bulk).
combination_map.rows_1: serial c1 owners (dense_single_local32 / dense_dual_local32 / t16_gemv_decode direct)
combination_map.rows_2_8: native rowtile: Q4 single dense_rowtile/_col4, Q4 gate/up dual q8_1x2 rowtile8, Q5 t16_gemv_rowtile (per-shape cap), Q6 lm_head t16_gemv_rowtile
combination_map.rows_9_511: Q4 single -> _rowtile8_row_chunks groups (8+2, 8+8, ...); Q4 gate/up -> dual rowtile8 chunked; Q5 single -> direct grid.y=rows leaf; Q6 lm_head -> chunked max 8
combination_map.mechanism: _native_rowtile_chunk_groups gates on (native session, 9<=rows<512, resolved variant startswith t16_wmma_prefill, registered rowtile owner)

benchmark.command: HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 python3 scripts/gguf_packed_ar_bench.py --backend hip_gfx1151 --model Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_S.gguf --quant gguf_q4_k_s --prompt-length 512 --decode-steps 64 --measured-runs 3 --configurations c1,c4,native_c8

rocprofv3.method: gguf_packed_ar_rocprof.py c8 eager, token 9707 exact, compiler-version-file prebuilt
rocprofv3.lm_head_note: q6_k_t16_qmicro_planar_gemv_rowtile_col8_kernel<float,8> runs once per decode token (8 launches for 8 rows) - single rows-8 lm_head launch replaces the prior 4+4 chunk (would have been 16 launches).

red_tests: test_gguf_q6_k_t16_rowtile_gemv rows 2..8 direct on the 35B fixture (standard Q6)
remaining_headroom: fp16 recurrent state (R2) ~6% decode gain, now harvestable after the dense path is fully native at c8
c9+ chunked rowtile8 groups carry a per-group weight-traversal; a single ROW_TILE>8 kernel could amortize further, but no measured decode concurrency above 8 is currently exercised
